messages:
kayla: Heads-up — vendor updated ETA for the 20-unit H100 top-off. They moved from 5 business days to ~12 due to a customs hold in FRA. Need to decide: air-expedite vs split AWB + loaners.
sanjay: Ugh. Do we have an AWB/RMA reference yet? Can procurement push an insurance uplift to cover expedite fees? :grimacing:
oliver: Vendor liaison here — RMA# RMA-89231, AWB currently N/A until forwarder clears; carrier flagged HS code mismatch on import docs. We can split shipment: 8 units immediate air (higher freight), 12 units delayed sea/air-mix.
kayla: If we split, which region pools get the immediate 8? Prefer APAC edge. Any thermal handling extra fees?
oliver: Yes — APAC pool can take 6, EU can take 2. Thermal packaging surcharge is +€45/unit for overnight air.
maria: Can finance approve the surcharge if procurement routes to expedite? What's the delta vs waiting 12 days? Need a quick cost calc.
sanjay: Quick back-of-envelope: expedite + thermal = ~€2.2k total. Waiting 12 days risks customer SLOs — possibly $15k in churn risk per day for that product line. I'd approve if RMAbot confirms insurance covers loss in transit.
rmabot: policy-check: expedited air with declared value uplift to 120% requires vendor-provided ADI and proof of customs corrective docs within 48h or claims may be denied.
kayla: Okay — action plan proposal: 1) Push vendor to provide corrected HS + prepaid reconsignment docs within 24h. 2) Approve split AWB: 8 units overnight to APAC (thermal), 12 units standard to EU sea/air. 3) Procurement to secure ADI and uplift insurance. 4) Finance to pre-approve surcharge cap €2.5k.
maria: I can pre-approve up to €2.5k if procurement straps back spot-rate exposure. Please include invoice split lines: freight, insurance uplift, customs correction fee, vendor credit note if applicable.
oliver: Will confirm with forwarder and vendor. Dropping the provisional AWB and cost table shortly. Tentative forwarder: SkyBridge Express — AWB placeholder: SBX000-1805554321.
sanjay: Great — once you have the AWB and vendor paperwork, tag @kayla and @maria. Also confirm the loaner flow: do we want 2-week loaners for critical APAC nodes?
kayla: Yes 2-week loaners if vendor can deliver within 48h of pickup. If not, we fallback to reserve pool and mark tickets as degraded.
oliver: vendor says loaner availability limited — can do 4 units loaner deployable within 24h. Will update RMA notes and attach forwarder manifest.
rmabot: incident-note auto-posted: provisioning impact ticket #INC-7821 created for APAC and EU pools.
maria: Thanks — once invoice lines come through, I'll confirm the payment path. If vendor offers partial credit for customs error, push for it and route to procurement for approval.
kayla: Sounds good. I'll keep this thread updated. If anyone hears new timing changes, paste them here. :thumbsup:
